merged.title: feat(overlays): decompile the per-level game code
merged.author: Veradictus
merged.untrustedBody:
## Summary

Each level's data file carries its own build of the game program (an
"overlay", ~1.1 MB of code per level), which replaces the executable's main
segment when the level loads. Until now the project only covered the
executable, about 13% of the game's distinct code. This PR adds the level
code: catalogue, assembly, sources, an exact-match check, progress
reporting, wave tooling, and the first 11 matched functions.

## Scale

- The 19 levels hold 21.5 MB of code, which reduces to 3.5 MB of distinct
  functions (4,040). Each distinct function is counted once.
- On average 91% of a level's code also appears elsewhere: a quarter is
  the executable's own game code, and two thirds is shared with other
  levels. Only ~9% is unique to one level.
- About half of the unique code has a close relative (≥75% similar) in
  another level (`config/overlays/families.tsv`).

## decomp.dev

opened.title: feat(overlays): 23 level-specific matches across 9 levels
opened.author: Veradictus
opened.untrustedBody:
## Summary

23 functions that exist in only one level, matched and landed one commit
each (1,620 bytes). They are the first real progress in the
"Level-specific code" category, which was at 0% before this.

| Level | Functions | Bytes |
|---|---|---|
| 02 | 1 | 104 |
| 07 | 2 | 148 |
| 12 | 1 | 80 |
| 13 | 3 | 152 |
| 14 | 2 | 168 |
| 15 | 1 | 140 |
| 16 | 3 | 92 |
| 17 | 1 | 192 |
| 18 | 9 | 544 |

Each function was checked with the strict overlay check (linked at its
address in its own level, every byte and relocation compared with the
level's code) and landed in its `src/overlays/lNN/` file.

## Progress

| | Before (upstream) | After |
|---|---|---|
| Headline | 7.92% | 7.97% |
| Level-specific code | 0% | 0.08% |
| Common level code | 2.68% | 2.68% |

The branch also carries merge commits syncing with upstream. Nothing
outside `src/overlays/lNN/` and `progress/report.json` changes, and no
executable sources are touched.
